item.title: SAP Concur Developer Center - API Release Notes, October 2026
item.description: API Release Notes, October 2026 New This Month Now Available: accessViaMobile Parameter in Hotel Service v4 The Hotel Service v4 API adds the accessViaMobile parameter to Reservation and Modify requests. This Boolean parameter indicates whether the request originates from a mobile device and defaults to false. Now Available: France e-Invoicing Integration Guide A new guide is now available on the SAP Concur developer portal to support partners and customers implementing France e-Invoicing. The guide covers integration requirements, workflow steps, and technical details for compliance with French e-invoicing regulations. See the France e-Invoicing Integration Guide for full details. item.title: SAP Concur Developer Center - API Release Notes, September 2026
item.description: API Release Notes, September 2026 New This Month Deprecation: Latest Bookings and Opportunities Effective September 14, 2026, the Latest Bookings and Opportunities APIs are deprecated. Decommission will follow. Preview: New Client SSL Certificate for *.api.concursolutions.com SAP Concur will renew the security certificate for *.api.concursolutions.com on November 10, 2026. In most cases, certificate renewal is automatic and transparent, and no action is required. This renewal is part of SAP Concur’s preparation for the upcoming DigiCert Global Root G5 migration (April 2027).
